params.name: registry_dataset
params.label: Comparison registry dataset
params.description: Select a dedicated empty Snowflake table dataset. The backend initializes its registry columns and DSS schema automatically. It needs dataset schema-write access and Snowflake table creation/alteration permissions for initial setup, then SELECT, INSERT, and UPDATE (plus DELETE for cleanup). Use one active preparation writer per registry dataset.
